import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix sex label variant (strip whitespace)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Fix body_mass_g written as text with commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    # Drop any sex values that are not allowed (shouldn't be after clean)
    df = df[df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
